description: Cross-boundary contract for the paid-runtime invocation. `status` is byte-for-byte what the Rust agent_runtime_get_status command serializes (pinned by desktop/src-tauri/src/commands/agent_runtime.rs tests). `expectedInvocation.runtimeTags` is what the desktop web layer must derive from that status and hand back to send_channel_message (pinned by desktop/src/features/agents/runtimeContract.test.mjs), and what the Rust message builder must accept (pinned by the same Rust test module). Scenario: a 15-minute pack was credited, one settled invocation used 60000 ms, and the 840000 ms remainder is locked in an open reservation.
